substeps.caption: A polished, mounted coupon goes onto the VHX-S750E's motorized XY stage (+-20 mm).
The free-angle head tilts to look at the surface from the side; the view stays centred on the coupon.
Upright again. Depth composition: the motorized Z focus sweeps through the relief and the controller keeps the sharp part of each frame (VH-ZST zoom: 20-2000x).
The EA-300 fires: a 355 nm Nd:YAG pulse (drawn red, and far wider than its 10 um spot) turns a speck of the surface into a plasma.
Its spectrometer reads the plasma's light: elements from H to U, in seconds, at the spot the camera is looking at.
The EA-300 adds 7.2 kg to the stand. Stand and head are about 656 mm tall: under Kardex's 727.5 mm.
